items.title: Soil biodiversity effects on ecosystems
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 土壤生物多样性对生态系统的影响
items.abstract_zh: 土壤生物多样性是生态系统功能的关键驱动因素，包括养分循环、有机物分解、植物生产力、气候调节和病原体控制（进而影响动物、人类和植物健康）。2014年的一项基础综述描述了土壤生物多样性在生态系统中的功能作用，但过去十年我们对土壤生物多样性与生态系统功能关系的理解得到了深入。在本综述中，我们重点介绍该领域的进展，讨论促成这些进展的方法和方法论进展，并识别新兴的研究问题。尽管土壤群落的时空模式和群落动态逐渐被广泛理解，但存在重要知识空白的主题包括土壤的气候反馈效应、城市土壤生态以及土壤健康指标的发展。全球协作网络、连接现有数据库以及监测土壤生物多样性和生态系统功能，是弥补这些知识空白的重要途径。通过考虑土壤、生物多样性与生态系统功能之间的关系，我们可以将植物、微生物和动物之间的小规模互动与生态系统服务和地球可持续性联系起来。

items.title: Paleogeography modulates marine extinction risk throughout the Phanerozoic
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Understanding the factors that have influenced the intensity and selectivity of extinction throughout Earth’s history is important for explaining past biodiversity change and forecasting biotic responses to environmental change. Here, we investigated the role of coastline geometry and paleogeographic boundary conditions in shaping extinction risk for shallow-marine taxa over the past 540 million years. We show that interactions between the geographic distributions of taxa and the geometric configurations of continental margins consistently predict relative extinction risk: Taxa with potential dispersal pathways that are long relative to the range of latitude traversed—such as those that occur along east-west–oriented coastlines, islands, or inland seaways—consistently exhibit higher extinction risk than taxa with potential dispersal pathways that provide more direct latitude-traversing paths. This dispersal distance selectivity is amplified during mass extinction events and hyperthermal intervals, suggesting that geographic constraints become more important during periods of rapid climate change. Our results provide another mechanism that potentially contributes to the generally elevated extinction rates during the Paleozoic, an interval characterized by complex inland seas and a preponderance of east-west coastlines. These insights underscore the importance of considering paleogeographic context when interpreting past extinction patterns and provide empirical support for assumptions that underlie extinction risk assessments of extant species.
items.title_zh: 古地理学调节了整个显生宙的海洋灭绝风险
items.abstract_zh: 理解影响地球灭绝强度和选择性的因素，对于解释过去的生物多样性变化和预测生物对环境变化的反应至关重要。本研究探讨了海岸线几何形态和古地理边界条件在过去5.4亿年间对浅海类群灭绝风险的影响。我们表明，分类单元地理分布与大陆边缘几何配置之间的相互作用一致预测相对灭绝风险：具有相对于穿越纬度范围较长的潜在扩散路径的分类单元——如东西向海岸线、岛屿或内陆海域分布的分类单元——其灭绝风险持续高于具有更直接纬度穿越路径的潜在扩散路径的分类单元。 这种扩散距离选择性在大规模灭绝事件和高热期间被放大，表明在快速气候变化时期，地理限制变得更加重要。我们的结果提供了另一种机制，可能促成古生代整体灭绝率较高的趋势，该时期以复杂的内陆海和东西向海岸线为主。这些见解强调了在解读过去灭绝模式时考虑古地理背景的重要性，并为对现存物种灭绝风险评估的假设提供了实证支持。

items.title: Changes in phenology mediate vertebrate population responses to temperature globally
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Phenotypic responses to climate affect individual fitness, but the extent to which this translates into effects on population dynamics remains poorly understood. We assemble 213 time series on phenotypes and population sizes of wild vertebrates globally and match them with local climate data. Our meta-analysis shows that morphological traits are mostly climate insensitive. However, phenology is earlier in warmer-than-average years, which contributes positively to population growth in most species. At lower latitudes, temperature has weaker effects on phenology but stronger direct negative effects on population growth, likely because these populations are less capable of tracking climate via plasticity. Variation in the phenology-mediated effect of temperature on population growth cannot be explained by latitude, generation time, migratory mode, or diet. This suggests that simple relationships between species characteristics and population responses to warming may not occur in nature. Instead, we may need to embrace ecological complexity by considering local-scale predictors that capture intra-specific variation.
items.title_zh: 物候变化介导全球脊椎动物种群对温度的反应
items.abstract_zh: 对气候的表型反应影响个体适应度，但这对种群动态的影响程度仍不十分明了。我们收集了213个关于野生脊椎动物表型和种群规模的时间序列，并将其与当地气候数据进行匹配。我们的荟萃分析显示，形态特征大多对气候无敏感性。然而，物候学在比平均温度较高的年份更早出现，这对大多数物种的种群增长有积极贡献。在低纬度地区，温度对物候的影响较弱，但对种群增长的直接负面影响更强，可能是因为这些种群较难通过可塑性追踪气候。温度介导的物候效应对种群增长的差异不能用纬度、世代时间、迁徙方式或饮食来解释。这表明，物种特征与种群对变暖的反应之间可能不存在简单的关系。相反，我们可能需要考虑捕捉种内变异的局部尺度预测变量，从而拥抱生态复杂性。

items.title: Climate and traits drive bark decomposition patterns at global scale
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Tree bark represents a large global carbon stock, comprising 2-20 % of woody biomass, and plays a distinct role in carbon and nutrient cycling. It is poorly understood how different abiotic and biotic drivers contribute to bark decomposition globally, or how these relationships play out in a changing climate. Here, we compile a global dataset to estimate the spatial variability of current bark decomposition rates (k values) and employ three machine learning approaches to project the response of k in future climate scenarios. We find that, globally, bark decomposes 2.9 times faster than the rate previously estimated for tree trunks (including bark). Mean k values increase latitudinally from 0.093 year-1 in the boreal region to 1.339 year-1 in the tropical region. Angiosperm bark decomposes faster (k = 0.450 year-1) than gymnosperm bark (0.198 year-1). Climate, especially mean annual temperature and mean annual precipitation, and bark phosphorus concentration, are the predominant factors driving bark decomposition. Four leading future climate scenarios predict bark decomposition to slow down in warm and wet regions and accelerate in cold and dry regions. Our results highlight the importance of considering bark decomposition in carbon cycling models. Bark decomposition could significantly affect global carbon and nutrient cycling. Here, the authors report the global trend of bark decomposition rates, identify the key drivers in different climate regions, and predict the response of bark decomposition to future climate change.
items.title_zh: 气候和性状在全球范围内决定树皮分解模式
items.abstract_zh: 树皮代表了全球大量的碳储备，占木本生物量的 2%至 20%，并在碳和养分循环中发挥着独特作用。目前尚不清楚不同非生物和生物驱动因素如何在全球范围内促成树皮分解，或这些关系在气候变化中如何表现。在这里，我们汇总了一个全球数据集，以估算当前树皮分解速率（*k* 值）的空间变异性，并采用三种机器学习方法预测 *k* 在未来气候情景中的响应。我们发现，全球范围内树皮分解速度是之前估计的树干（包括树皮）的 2.9 倍。平均 *k* 值从北方针叶区的 0.093 年-(1) 年-1 向上升至热带区的 1.339 年-(1)。被子植物树皮分解速度比裸子植物树皮（0.198( 年）) 更快（*k* = 0.450( 年）。) 气候，尤其是年平均气温和年平均降水量，以及树皮磷浓度，是导致树皮分解的主要因素。四种主要未来气候情景预测，温暖和湿润地区树皮分解将减缓，而寒冷和干燥地区则加速。我们的结果强调了在碳循环模型中考虑树皮分解的重要性。

items.title: Meta-analysis reveals negative but highly variable impacts of invasive alien species across terrestrial insect orders
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Insects are crucial to ecosystem functioning but face numerous threats, with invasive alien species likely among the most severe. As insect declines continue, there is a growing need to synthesise evidence on how invasive alien species affect insects, as research has historically focused more on insects as invaders than as victims. Here we conduct a global meta-analysis encompassing 318 effect sizes across 52 studies, assessing invasive alien species impact on terrestrial insect orders (Coleoptera, Hemiptera, Hymenoptera, and Orthoptera), and examining factors influencing these effects. We show that invasive alien species reduce the abundance of insects included in our study by 31%, and species richness by 26%, though these impacts are highly variable across taxa. Stronger negative impacts are found for invasive alien animals compared to invasive alien plants, and for Hemiptera (true bugs) and Hymenoptera (bees, wasps, ants) compared to Coleoptera (beetles). These findings provide quantitative estimates for the relative vulnerability of insects to invasive alien species, which is an important step towards halting declines.
items.title_zh: 荟萃分析揭示了入侵外来物种在陆生昆虫目中产生的负面但高度变异的影响
items.abstract_zh: 昆虫对生态系统运作至关重要，但面临诸多威胁，其中入侵外来物种可能是最严重的之一。随着昆虫数量持续下降，越来越多的人需要综合证据来了解入侵外来物种如何影响昆虫，因为历来研究更多关注昆虫作为入侵者而非受害者。本研究涵盖52项研究的318个效应量，我们进行了全球荟萃分析，评估入侵外来物种对陆生昆虫目（鞘翅目、半翅目、膜翅目和直翅目）的影响，并探讨影响这些影响的因素。我们发现入侵外来物种使研究中包含的昆虫数量减少31%，物种丰富度减少26%，尽管这些影响在不同分类单元间差异很大。入侵外来动物的负面影响比入侵外来植物更强烈，而半翅目（真正的昆虫）和膜翅目（蜜蜂、黄蜂、蚂蚁）则相较于鞘翅目（甲虫）的影响更为明显。这些发现为昆虫对入侵外来物种的相对脆弱性提供了定量估计，这是阻止下降的重要一步。

items.title: Distance-decay reveals contrasting effects of land-use types on arthropod community homogenisation
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Homogenisation caused by intensive land-use is one of the drivers of global biodiversity decline. However, the contribution of land-use intensity to insect diversity loss is still largely untested. Therefore, we compare the rate of species homogenisation of ~12.000 arthropod species (using Barcode Index Numbers) from 450 families, using distance-decay relationships. We study communities along an increasing local land-use intensity gradient from forests to managed grasslands, to arable lands and to settlements situated within near-natural, agricultural, and urban regional landscapes. Our approach for incidence data under consideration of incomplete samples identifies that grasslands harbour the most homogenous communities after taking frequency and species traits into account. In contrast, the most modified land-use types, settlements, and arable lands do not differ from forests, and showed the most heterogeneous communities between locations. Large- and low-mobility species communities are the most heterogeneous in space, but patterns are dependent on local land-use. Regional landscapes modify the community response to local land-use types: near-natural landscapes reduce homogenisation, while agricultural landscapes increase homogenisation. Based on our findings we recommend enhanced conservation efforts particularly in managed grasslands to reverse homogenisation, while settlements and arable lands could be considered more in arthropod community heterogenisation.
items.title_zh: 距离衰变揭示了土地利用类型对节肢动物群落均质化的不同影响
items.abstract_zh: 密集土地利用导致的同质化是全球生物多样性衰退的驱动力之一。然而，土地利用强度对昆虫多样性丧失的贡献仍大多未被验证。因此，我们比较了来自450个科的~12,000种节肢动物物种（使用条形码索引编号），采用距离-衰变关系。我们研究社区沿着从森林到管理草原、耕地以及位于近自然、农业和城市区域景观中的定居点，逐步增加的本地土地利用强度梯度。我们对不完整样本的发生数据方法指出，考虑频率和物种特征后，草原拥有最同质的群落。相比之下，最明显的土地利用类型、定居点和耕地与森林无异，且显示出不同地点间最为异质的群落。大型和低流动性物种群落在空间上最为异质，但其模式依赖于当地土地利用。区域景观改变了社区对地方土地利用类型的反应：近自然景观减少了均质化，而农业景观则增加了均质化。基于我们的发现，我们建议加强保护工作，特别是在管理草地中，以逆转均质化，而定居点和耕地则更多地被视为节肢动物群落异质化。

items.title: Exposure of western United States bird communities to predicted high severity fire
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Fire is a pervasive biogeographic process that shapes biodiversity globally and is now experiencing unprecedented changes. Despite well documented impacts of fires on biodiversity, we do not know where biodiversity might be most vulnerable to changing fire regimes. We leverage recent advancements in fire forecasting and species distribution modeling to assess the exposure of bird species richness, community uniqueness, and functional richness to altered fire regimes in the western United States. We find that 55-58% of biodiversity hotspots are classified as “refugia”, where high biodiversity intersects with predicted low severity burn areas. In contrast, 24-30% of biodiversity hotspots are classified as “areas of concern”, where high biodiversity intersected with predicted high severity burn areas. Over half (52-60%) of “areas of concern” occur in geographies with historically low-severity fire regimes; a fire regime mismatch indicating a potential threat to biodiversity. We find that species with a preference for high-density vegetation and with shallower beak depth are most likely to be exposed to high severity fire, indicating a potential for habitat losses for species with these traits. Our findings reinforce calls for targeted management to reduce impacts of future fire where it is predicted to be outside the historical range of variation.
items.title_zh: 美国西部鸟类群落暴露于预测的高严重火灾
items.abstract_zh: 火是一个普遍的生物地理过程，塑造着全球的生物多样性，并且正经历前所未有的变化。尽管火灾对生物多样性的影响有充分记录，但我们尚不清楚生物多样性在哪些方面最易受到火灾变化的影响。我们利用火灾预测和物种分布模型的最新进展，评估美国西部鸟类物种丰富度、群落独特性和功能丰富度在火灾模式变化下的影响。我们发现，55%-58%的生物多样性热点被归类为“避难区”，即高生物多样性与预测的低严重烧毁区交汇处。相比之下，24-30%的生物多样性热点被归类为“关注区”，即高生物多样性与预测的高严重烧毁区交汇。超过一半（52-60%）的“关注区域”发生在历史上火灾严重度较低的地理区域;火灾状况不匹配，表明对生物多样性存在潜在威胁。我们发现，偏好高密度植被且喙部较浅的物种最有可能暴露于高强度火灾，这表明具有这些特征的物种栖息地可能丧失。我们的发现强化了针对性管理的呼吁，以减少未来火灾影响，尤其是在预测火灾超出历史变异范围的情况下。

items.title: Global evidence that plant diversity suppresses pests and promotes plant performance and crop production
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 全球证据表明植物多样性能抑制害虫，促进植物表现和作物产量
items.abstract_zh: 多样性-生产力关系表明，增加植物物种可以提高初级生产力，这一效应部分归因于植物拮抗剂的抑制。我们综合了609项研究，探讨植物多样性如何影响植物及其拮抗剂。我们展示了增加植物种类在农业生态系统、草原和森林、草本和木本植物、热带和温带地区，以及替代系列和增法实验设计研究中，持续促进植物表现并抑制拮抗剂表现。作物多样化（例如间作和覆盖作物）通过抑制害虫间接促进作物产量。这表明多样化种植系统可以在减少对合成农药依赖的同时提高生产力，为农业从自给自足到大规模农业提供了可持续的路径。总体来看，这些结果表明作物多样化具有相当潜力支持可持续农业生态系统，既能提升生产力，又减少对合成农药的依赖。

items.title: Tree diversity is changing across tropical Andean and Amazonian forests in response to global change
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Climate and atmospheric changes are impacting forest function and structure worldwide, but their effects on tropical forest diversity are unclear. Nowhere is the scientific challenge greater than in the Andes and the Amazon, which together include the world’s most diverse forests. Here, using 406 permanent plots spanning four decades of intact lowland and montane forest dynamics, we test for long-term change in species richness and assess the influence of climate and other variables. We show that, at a continental scale, species richness appears stable, but this masks substantial regional variation. Species richness increased in Northern Andean and Western Amazon plots, yet declined in the Central Andes, Guyana Shield and Central-Eastern Amazon. Overall, warmer, drier and more seasonal forests lost species, while those at higher elevations, in less fragmented areas and with faster rates of tree turnover experienced increases. Region-specific drivers, particularly precipitation seasonality and demographic factors, modulated these trends. The results highlight the diverse ways in which Amazon–Andes forests are changing and underscore the critical need to preserve large-scale ecosystem integrity to maintain local tree diversity. By doing so, Northern Andean forests in particular could serve as an important refuge for species increasingly displaced by climate change.
items.title_zh: 随着全球变化，热带安第斯山脉和亚马逊森林的树木多样性正在发生变化
items.abstract_zh: 气候和大气变化正在影响全球森林的功能和结构，但它们对热带森林多样性的影响尚不明确。科学挑战最大的地区莫过于安第斯山脉和亚马逊地区，这两地共同拥有世界上最多样化的森林。在这里，我们利用406个永久地块，涵盖四十年的完整低地和山地森林动态，检验物种丰富度的长期变化，并评估气候及其他变量的影响。我们表明，在大陆尺度上，物种丰富度看似稳定，但这掩盖了显著的区域变异。北安第斯和西亚马逊地块的物种丰富度有所增加，而中安第斯、圭亚那地盾和中东亚马逊则有所下降。总体来看，温暖、干燥和季节性更强的森林物种减少，而高海拔、支离破碎且树木更替速度快的森林物种减少。地区特定的驱动因素，尤其是降水季节性和人口因素，调节了这些趋势。结果凸显了亚马逊-安第斯森林变化的多样方式，并强调了维护大规模生态系统完整性以维持本地树木多样性的关键必要性。通过这样做，北安第斯森林尤其可能成为气候变化日益驱逐物种的重要避难所。

items.title: Aligning climate-smart marine spatial planning and ecoscape restoration for global biodiversity recovery
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 将气候智能型海洋空间规划与生态景观修复相结合，以实现全球生物多样性恢复
items.abstract_zh: 实现《生物多样性公约》（CBD）昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架（GBF）设定的雄心目标，将需要扩大海洋和沿海生态系统的治理领域恢复。海洋空间规划（MSP）在海洋中平衡多重人类利用与生态系统健康的维护，可能是实现这一目标的最有效途径。然而，迄今为止，最低支持计划和恢复工作各自推进，生物多样性流失仍在持续。在本视角中，我们详细阐述了如何将恢复纳入场地尺度的规划，配合次国家或国家级最低支持计划，帮助实现多个同时进行的全球生物多样性目标。我们概述了四条支持长期生物多样性积极成果的行动途径：确保灵活且多尺度的方法;使规划以社区为中心;保持社会与生态的联系;并评估与气候相关的风险和机遇。随后，我们提出了 CBD 相关方可用于实施和跟踪生态景观修复融入气候智慧型 MSP 进展的指标。随着全球关注 GBF 的到来以及 2030 年截止日期的临近，实施这些拟议行动途径有望更快实现全球目标。

items.title: Bending back the curve of shark and ray biodiversity loss
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 扭转鲨鱼和鳐鱼生物多样性流失的曲线
items.abstract_zh: 鲨鱼和魟鱼是海洋状态的守护者。自20世纪中叶以来，整体数量下降了近65%，超过三分之一（37.5%）的物种面临威胁，导致群落结构发生广泛变化。这场危机源于无监管的渔业扩张，加上捕捞贸易监测不足，未能考虑到鲨鱼和鳐鱼产品的复杂性、使用及其全球贸易流向。在本综述中，我们评估了全球鲨鱼和鳟鱼种群的现状、扭转其下降的补救措施，以及保护面临的挑战和障碍。关键数据中明显的地理和分类偏差依然存在，需要集成物种分布建模、数据动员、性状预测以及新的渔业威胁地图。解决管理缺口需要基于监管和市场的方法，最终必须降低渔业死亡率，将国际框架与国家渔业管理工具相结合，并通过在供需链上实施健全的合规管理，实施管理层级的缓解措施。案例研究揭示了管理效果的优缺点，并展示了广域和有限分布物种的成功恢复。最后，我们确定了6个关键挑战，并提出了25个研究问题和可作的建议，以扭转鲨鱼和鳟鱼生物多样性流失的曲线。

items.title: European forest carbon and biodiversity policies have a limited win-win potential
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Climate change mitigation and biodiversity conservation are key forest functions, but how to pursue them jointly in timber-managed forests is still unclear. We use a Europe-wide dataset of forest multi-taxon diversity and stand structure to (i) evaluate the importance of aboveground carbon stocks in determining species richness of six taxonomic groups; (ii) assess relationships between species richness and carbon stocks; (iii) discuss the potential to jointly enhance carbon and biodiversity and policy implications. Carbon-diversity relationships are positive for several groups, but mostly when deadwood pools are considered. Forest policies should consider the complex relationship between different carbon pools and taxonomic groups. Environmental policies emphasizing carbon sequestration in aboveground living biomass may conflict with biodiversity conservation by promoting homogeneous, fast-growing forests that fail to support species diversity of multiple groups. Sustainable forest management should acknowledge that deadwood carbon instead may translate into positive outcomes for both carbon storage and biodiversity conservation. Forests are essential for both climate change mitigation and biodiversity conservation, yet how to balance these goals in managed forests remains unclear. Here, using a Europe-wide dataset, the authors find that biodiversity increases with carbon stocks, but mostly when deadwood is included.
items.title_zh: 欧洲森林碳和生物多样性政策的双赢潜力有限
items.abstract_zh: 森林的首要功能是减缓气候变化和保护生物多样性，但如何在以木材为生的森林中共同追求这些功能仍不清楚。我们使用了欧洲范围内的多种群森林多样性和林分结构数据集，用于 (i) 评估陆地碳储量在确定六个分类群的物种丰富度中的重要性；(ii) 评估物种丰富度与碳储量之间的关系；(iii) 讨论共同提高碳和生物多样性以及政策影响的潜力。 对于一些群体来说，碳多样性关系是正向的，但主要是在考虑死树池的情况下。森林政策应考虑不同碳池和分类群之间的复杂关系。强调活体地上生物量碳库的环境政策可能会与保护生物多样性相冲突，因为它们会促进单一的、快速生长的森林，而这些森林无法支持多种群的物种多样性。可持续的森林管理应该认识到，枯木的碳储存可能会对碳储存和生物多样性保护产生积极影响。

items.title: Commercial fishing amplifies impacts of increasing temperature on predator-prey interactions in marine ecosystems
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Predator-prey interactions determine food web structure, energy flux, and ecosystem stability. Increasing temperatures and commercial fishing both alter body size distributions that underpin predator-prey interactions, but empirical evidence of their individual and combined effects is limited. We study how the predator to prey body mass ratio (PPMR) changes as a function of temperature and fishing effort in over 50,000 predator stomachs collected across the Northeast Atlantic over 35 years. PPMR increases with temperature, an effect that is exacerbated by greater fishing effort, driven by intraspecific decreases in prey body mass in heavily fished areas. To compensate for smaller prey (both within and across species) in warmer waters and areas of high fishing, predators target the largest prey available to them, but this is insufficient to alter the community-wide increase in PPMR. Higher PPMR is associated with weaker trophic interactions that dampen strong oscillatory dynamics but could also reduce energy transfer efficiency within ecosystems, both of which can affect ecosystem stability. These results could help underpin ecosystem-based management and sustainable fisheries by providing estimates of how future climate warming might interact with fishing to affect energy flux through marine food webs.
items.title_zh: 商业捕捞加剧了海洋生态系统中温度上升对捕食者和猎物相互作用的影响
items.abstract_zh: 捕食者-猎物相互作用决定了食物网的结构、能量流动和生态系统稳定性。温度升高和商业捕捞都会改变基础为捕食者-猎物相互作用的体长分布。但对其单独和联合影响的实证证据有限。我们研究了 35 年来在东北大西洋收集的 50,000 多个捕食者胃中，捕食者和猎物的体质量比（PPMR）如何随温度和捕捞努力程度的变化。 温度升高会增加 PPMR，而更大的捕捞努力则会加剧这一效应，因为捕捞强度在捕捞量高的地区会降低猎物的体重。为了弥补温度较高的水域和捕捞量高的地区的较小猎物（包括物种内部），捕食者瞄准了它们能找到的最大猎物，但这不足以改变 PPMR 在整个群落中所增加的幅度。 更高的 PPMR 与更弱的营养相互作用有关，这会抑制强烈的振荡动力学，但也会降低生态系统内能量转移的效率，这两者都会影响生态系统稳定性。这些结果可以帮助支持基于生态系统的管理和可持续渔业，提供未来气候变暖如何与捕捞活动相互作用，影响海洋食物网中能量流动的估计。

items.title: Critical thresholds for co-benefits of carbon accumulation and biodiversity conservation under global nitrogen enrichment
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Global nitrogen (N) enrichment promotes soil organic carbon (SOC) accumulation but often causes biodiversity loss in plants and soil microbes, creating a central challenge for achieving co-benefits of carbon accumulation and biodiversity conservation. The extent to which biodiversity contributes to SOC accumulation, and how these trade-offs can be mitigated under N enrichment remains poorly understood. Here, we conduct a global meta-analysis of N enrichment experiments encompassing 2141 observations from 275 studies to evaluate the contributions of plant, bacterial, and fungal diversity to SOC accumulation and to determine associated ecological thresholds. Our findings indicate that biodiversity, especially in plant communities, is the most important factor for SOC accumulation. We identify three distinct N thresholds characterized by different ecological responses: biodiversity loss accelerates at 50 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, soil degradation persists at 200 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, and SOC accumulation declines beyond this point. Given that the promoting effects of bacterial, fungal, and plant diversity on SOC diminish or even reverse at 50, 67, and 74 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, respectively, we suggest limiting fertilization to around 50 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, as the trade-off between biodiversity loss and SOC accumulation under N enrichment is potentially minimized.
items.title_zh: 在全球氮浓缩下碳积累与生物多样性保护的共益临界阈值
items.abstract_zh: 全球氮（N）富集促进土壤有机碳（SOC）的积累，但常常导致植物和土壤微生物的生物多样性丧失，这成为实现碳积累与生物多样性保护共益的关键挑战。生物多样性对 SOC 积累的贡献程度，以及在氮肥富集下如何缓解这些权衡，仍不十分明了。本文对 N 富集实验进行了全球荟萃分析，涵盖 275 项研究中的 2141 条观测，以评估植物、细菌和真菌多样性对 SOC 积累的贡献，并确定相关的生态阈值。我们的发现表明，生物多样性，尤其是植物群落，是 SOC 积累的最重要因素。我们识别出三种不同的 N 阈值，其生态反应各异：生物多样性丧失在 50 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹时加速，土壤退化在 200 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹时持续，SOC 积累在此点之后下降。鉴于细菌、真菌和植物多样性对 SOC 的促进作用分别在 50、67 和 74 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹时减弱甚至逆转，我们建议将施肥限制在约 50 kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹，这样生物多样性丧失与氮富集下 SOC 积累之间的权衡可能最小化。

items.title: Geographic distribution of nematodes in the Atacama is associated with elevation, climate gradients and parthenogenesis
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Soil ecosystems are crucial for supporting life, yet little is known about their biodiversity and its distribution in extreme environments. The Atacama Desert, the driest non-polar desert on Earth, has scarce water, high salinity, and metal-rich water bodies, creating challenging conditions for most organisms. Above-ground life has been partially documented, but its soils remain poorly studied. Here we show that soil nematodes, an abundant and diverse group of invertebrates, display distinct biodiversity patterns across the Atacama at multiple biological scales, including genetic, taxonomic, community, and life-cycle levels. Surveys across dune systems, high-altitude mountains, saline lakes, river valleys, and fog oases reveal unique assemblages in each habitat. We find that asexual taxa are more common at higher altitudes, consistent with patterns of geographical parthenogenesis. Genus richness follows a latitudinal gradient and increases with precipitation. These results demonstrate that even in one of the most extreme terrestrial environments, stable soil communities can persist. However, evidence of simplified soil food webs suggests vulnerability to further environmental change. Our findings provide new insights into the mechanisms shaping biodiversity in arid ecosystems and can inform predictions about soil resilience under global climate-driven aridification.
items.title_zh: 阿塔卡马线虫的地理分布与海拔、气候梯度和孤雌生殖有关
items.abstract_zh: 土壤生态系统对于支持生命至关重要，但关于其生物多样性及其在极端环境中的分布知之甚少。阿塔卡马沙漠是地球上最干燥的非极地沙漠，水资源稀缺，盐度高，水体富含金属，为大多数生物创造了挑战性环境。地面上生物已有部分记录，但其土壤研究仍然不足。我们展示了土壤线虫——一类丰富多样的无脊椎动物——在阿塔卡马地区，在遗传、分类、群落和生命周期等多个生物学层面上展现出独特的生物多样性模式。对沙丘系统、高海拔山脉、盐湖、河谷和雾绿洲的调查揭示了每个栖息地中独特的组合。我们发现无性分类单元在高海拔地区更为常见，这与地理上的孤雌生殖模式相符。属的丰富度呈纬度梯度，并随降水增加而增加。这些结果表明，即使在极端的陆地环境中，稳定的土壤群落依然可以持续存在。然而，简化的土壤食物网证据表明其易受进一步环境变化的影响。我们的发现为干旱生态系统中塑造生物多样性的机制提供了新的见解，并可为预测全球气候驱动干旱下土壤韧性提供参考。

items.title: Landscape effects on global soil pathogenic fungal diversity across spatial scales
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Growing evidence has shown that, apart from local environmental factors, changes in landscape-level factors by accelerated land-use change can also shape soil pathogenic fungal diversity. However, the global representativeness of such patterns remains unclear. Here, we assess how pathogenic fungal diversity in 511 soil samples worldwide responds to landscape factors, including landscape complexity index based on eight landscape metrics and quantity of different land cover types across six spatial scales (i.e., surrounding landscape, 250 m to 10,000 m radii from the sampling coordinate). We find that while soil variables explain over half of the variance, pathogenic fungal alpha diversity increases with landscape complexity and crop cover proportion, but decreases with grass and tree cover proportion, together explaining 23.4% of the total variance. Landscape factors have weaker impacts on beta diversity, explaining 13.0% of the variance. Across spatial scales, grassland ecosystems exhibit increasingly stronger responses to landscape variables compared to forest ecosystems. Landscape factors have a higher relative contribution to root-associated fungi than leaf/fruit/seed-associated fungi. Our results emphasize the importance of local factors and the complementary role of landscape patterns in shaping global soil pathogenic fungal distributions, highlighting scale-dependent effects across ecosystems and fungal functional groups.
items.title_zh: 景观对全球土壤致病真菌多样性在不同空间尺度上的影响
items.abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，除了局部环境因素外，加速土地利用变化对景观层面因素的影响还能塑造土壤致病真菌多样性。然而，这些模式的全球代表性仍不明确。本研究，我们评估全球511个土壤样本中的致病真菌多样性如何响应景观因素，包括基于八项景观指标的景观复杂性指数，以及六个空间尺度（即从抽样坐标出发250米至10,000米半径的周边景观）。我们发现，虽然土壤变量解释了超过一半的变异，但致病真菌α多样性随景观复杂性和作物覆盖比例增加而增加，但随着草和树木覆盖比例减少，合计解释了总方差的23.4%。景观因素对β多样性的影响较弱，解释了13.0%的方差。在不同空间尺度上，草原生态系统对景观变量的响应比森林生态系统更强烈。景观因素对根相关真菌的相对贡献高于叶片/果实/种子相关真菌。我们的结果强调了局部因素的重要性以及景观模式在塑造全球土壤致病真菌分布中的互补作用，强调了生态系统和真菌功能群中尺度依赖效应。

items.title: Energy and biomass distribution in soil food webs of temperate and tropical forests
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Soil food webs channel most of the energy in terrestrial ecosystems. Temperate and tropical forests host different soil invertebrate communities, but consequent differences in the structure and functioning of soil food webs between these major biomes remain unknown. Here, we calculate energy fluxes to explore generic patterns in biomass and energy distribution across micro-, meso- and macrofauna in forest ecosystems spanning from southern taiga to tropical rainforests. Tropical soil food webs have either larger (monsoon forest) or smaller (rainforest) animal biomass than temperate ones, but have consistently higher energy flux, higher share of large organisms (macrofauna) in total biomass and distinct energy distribution. Specifically, tropical soil food webs have proportionally higher predation rates than temperate soil food webs and rely more on plant consumption (living roots), but less on bacterial, fungal and litter consumption. Earthworms act as food-web engineers promoting detrital energy pathways (litter, soil and deadwood consumption) in mixed broadleaved forests overriding climate-associated differences among forests. Our study shows a major change in soil food web from “brown” temperate to “green” tropical functional state, explaining functional implications of soil invertebrate community turnover across biomes.
items.title_zh: 温带和热带森林土壤食物网中的能源与生物量分布
items.abstract_zh: 土壤食物网将大部分能量引导到陆地生态系统中。温带和热带森林拥有不同的土壤无脊椎动物群落，但因此这些主要生物群落在土壤食物网结构和功能的差异仍不清楚。在这里，我们计算能量通量，以探索从南部针叶林到热带雨林的森林生态系统中，微型、中型和大型动物群中生物量和能量分布的通用模式。热带土壤食物网的动物生物量要么比温带地区更大（季风森林）要么更小（雨林），但能量通量始终更高，大型生物（大型动物）在总生物量中占比更高，能量分布也各异。具体来说，热带土壤食物网的捕食率比例高于温带土壤食物网，且更多依赖植物（活根）的食用，但较少依赖细菌、真菌和落叶的摄入。蚯蚓作为食物网工程师，促进混合阔叶林中的碎屑能量路径（落叶、土壤和枯木消耗），覆盖森林间气候相关的差异。我们的研究显示，土壤食物网从“棕色”温带状态向“绿色”热带功能状态发生了重大变化，解释了土壤无脊椎动物群落在不同生物群系更替的功能意义。

items.title: Climatic niche conservatism in non-native plants depends on introduction history and biogeographic context
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Niche conservatism is a fundamental assumption in predictive models for managing non-native species, but its generality remains debated due to mixed empirical evidence. We argue that this reflects underexplored context dependencies, as few studies have compared the niche dynamics of species introduced to multiple regions. Here, we quantify climatic niche changes in 1566 introductions of 316 non-native plant species across eight regions, including continents and archipelagos. While niche expansion into previously unoccupied conditions was low, niche conservatism and unfilling varied strongly across regions. Species with small native range sizes exhibited greater niche expansion. Longer residence times reduced niche unfilling, suggesting that a lack of niche conservatism observed in many regions might be transient and potentially linked to dispersal limitations. Our results highlight the necessity to consider region-specific contexts when assessing the potential for niche changes and provide a critical foundation for improving predictive models informing the management of non-native species.
items.title_zh: 非本地植物的气候生态位保守性取决于引入、历史和生物地理背景
items.abstract_zh: 生态位保守主义是管理外来物种预测模型中的基本假设，但由于实证证据不一，其普遍性仍存在争议。我们认为这反映了尚未被充分探索的情境依赖性，因为很少有研究比较引入多个区域物种的生态位动态。在这里，我们量化了1566个引入的316种外来植物，涵盖八个区域（包括大陆和群岛）的气候生态位变化。虽然利基市场向此前未被占据的地区扩展较少，但利基保守主义和空缺在不同地区差异显著。原生分布范围较小的物种表现出更大的生态位扩展。较长的居住时间减少了生态位的不填充，表明许多地区观察到的生态位保守性缺失可能是暂时性的，且可能与扩散限制有关。我们的结果强调了在评估生态位变化潜力时必须考虑区域特有的背景，并为改进外来物种管理预测模型提供了关键基础。

items.title: Global nitrogen enrichment impacts plant diversity more than soil bacterial and fungal diversity: a meta-analysis
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Anthropogenic nitrogen enrichment has significant effects on plant and soil biodiversity across local to global scales, yet how the nitrogen-induced changes in plant diversity differ from those in soil organisms across multiple ecosystems and climatic conditions remains virtually unknown. By synthesizing plant and soil studies globally (3,816 paired observations from 458 articles), we demonstrate that nitrogen enrichment has stronger negative effects on plant diversity but surprisingly modest to negligible effects on soil bacterial and fungal diversity. On average, nitrogen enrichment results in 8.3% and 10.3% reductions in species richness and Shannon index for plants. In contrast, it leads to 1.9% and 0.2% reductions for soil bacteria and <0.4% changes for soil fungi, respectively. The nitrogen-induced soil acidification modulates soil biodiversity change and, in conjunction with aboveground biomass, regulates plant biodiversity change. Our findings provide a perspective on the differential impacts of global nitrogen enrichment on above- and below-ground biodiversity, highlighting the need for integrated biodiversity conservation strategies. Addressing how the nitrogen-induced changes in plant diversity differ from those in soil organisms is critical. This global meta-analysis suggests that nitrogen enrichment has stronger negative effects on plant diversity but modest to negligible effects on soil bacterial and fungal diversity.
items.title_zh: 全球氮富集对植物多样性的影响大于土壤、细菌和真菌多样性：荟萃分析
items.abstract_zh: 人为氮肥富集对植物和土壤生物多样性在本地到全球范围内都有显著影响，但氮诱导的植物多样性变化与土壤生物在多个生态系统和气候条件下的变化有何不同，仍几乎未知。通过综合全球植物和土壤研究（共458篇文章共3,816条配对观察），我们证明氮肥富集对植物多样性的负面影响更强，但对土壤细菌和真菌多样性的影响却出人意料地微乎其微甚至微乎其微。平均而言，氮肥富集导致植物物种丰富度和香农指数分别降低8.3%和10.3%。相比之下，土壤细菌减少1.9%和0.2%，土壤真菌减少<0.4%。氮诱导的土壤酸化调节土壤生物多样性变化，并结合地面生物量调节植物生物多样性变化。我们的研究结果为全球氮肥集对地下和地下生物多样性的不同影响提供了视角，强调了整合生物多样性保护策略的必要性。

items.title: A new era of bioclimatic extremes in the terrestrial Arctic
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: The Arctic climate is rapidly warming, but long-term changes in extreme weather events that cause major ecosystem disturbances are not well understood. Here, by using a state-of-the-art atmospheric reanalysis spanning the past seven decades, we show that, in many parts of the terrestrial Arctic, the frequency of extreme weather events has increased sharply. We found pronounced spatial variability in bioclimatic extremes during the past 30 years, including more droughts in the high-Arctic and greater area affected by winter-warming and rain-on-snow events, especially in the European Arctic region. Across one-third of the Arctic domain, such extreme events have only recently begun to occur. Thus, the Arctic is entering a novel era of bioclimatic extremes with likely severe consequences on cold ecosystems.
items.title_zh: 陆地北极生物极端气候的新纪元
items.abstract_zh: 北极气候正在迅速变暖，但极端天气事件导致重大生态系统扰动的长期变化尚不十分了解。通过利用跨越过去七十年的先进大气再分析，我们表明，在陆地北极的许多地区，极端天气事件的频率急剧上升。我们发现过去30年生物气候极端的空间变异显著，包括高北极地区干旱增加，以及受冬季变暖和降雪事件影响的更大区域，尤其是在欧洲北极地区。在北极区域的三分之一区域，此类极端事件直到最近才开始发生。因此，北极正进入一个生物气候极端的新时代，可能对寒冷生态系统产生严重后果。

items.title: Forest loss intensifies meteorological drought in more than half of Earth’s climate zones
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Global forest loss increases the risk of meteorological drought by altering surface energy balances. While local impacts on temperature and precipitation are known, the extent and underlying mechanisms of its influence on meteorological drought remain unclear. Here, we analyzed 3696 paired forest loss and intact sites across boreal, temperate, and tropical zones. Forest loss intensified meteorological drought in more than 52% of affected regions. Drought prevalence in boreal zones rose by 5% over 20 years—three times greater than in tropical zones—because of reduced latent heat flux and increased surface albedo, which together suppressed convective rainfall. In contrast, tropical forests demonstrated greater ecological resilience, mitigating ~40% of meteorological drought intensification. Notably, forest loss–induced meteorological drought may further evolve into more severe agricultural and hydrological droughts. Therefore, we recommend implementing strategies tailored for each climate zone, including native forest conservation, proactive ecological restoration, and connectivity enhancement, to effectively reduce drought risk.
items.title_zh: 森林流失加剧了地球上一半以上气候区的气象干旱
items.abstract_zh: 全球森林流失通过改变地表能源平衡，增加了气象干旱的风险。虽然已知局部对温度和降水的影响，但其对气象干旱影响的范围和潜在机制尚不明确。我们分析了北针林、温带和热带地区的3696个成对森林丧失和完整地点。森林流失加剧了超过52%受影响地区的气象干旱。北方地区20年间干旱流行率上升了5%，是热带地区的三倍，原因是潜热通量减少和地表反照率增加，这两者共同抑制了对流降雨。相比之下，热带森林展现出更高的生态韧性，减轻了约40%的气象干旱加剧。值得注意的是，森林损失引起的气象干旱可能进一步演变成更严重的农业和水文干旱。因此，我们建议针对每个气候区实施针对性制定的策略，包括原生森林保护、主动生态恢复和提升连通性，以有效降低干旱风险。

items.title: Mass extinction triggered the early radiations of jawed vertebrates and their jawless relatives (gnathostomes)
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Most vertebrate lineages are first recorded from the mid-Paleozoic, well after their Cambrian origin and Ordovician invertebrate biodiversification events. This delay has been poorly understood and is usually attributed to sampling and long ghost lineages. We analyzed newly compiled databases of Paleozoic vertebrate occurrences, biogeography, and ecosystems, revealing that the Late Ordovician Mass Extinction (~445 to 443 million years ago) triggered parallel, endemic radiations of jawed and related jawless vertebrates (gnathostomes) in isolated refugia. Postextinction ecosystems hosted the first definitive appearances of most major vertebrate lineages of the Paleozoic “Age of Fishes” (and today), following the loss of ubiquitous stem-cyclostome conodonts, nascent faunas of other gnathostomes, and pelagic invertebrates. Turnover and recovery patterns matched those following climatically similar events like the end-Devonian mass extinction, including a postextinction “gap” with low biodiversity. The prolonged Silurian recovery, and the challenges of oceanic dispersal, likely further delayed the dominance of jawed gnathostomes for millions of years after the first fossil jaws.
items.title_zh: 大灭绝事件推动了有颌脊椎动物及其无颌近亲的早期辐射演化（有颌类）
items.abstract_zh: 大多数脊椎动物谱系最早记录于古生代中，远晚于寒武纪起源和奥陶纪无脊椎动物生物多样化事件。这一延迟一直被误解，通常归因于采样和幽灵谱系的较长。我们分析了新编纂的古生代脊椎动物分布数据库、生物地理学和生态系统，揭示晚奥陶纪大灭绝（~4.45亿至4.43亿年前）引发了孤立避难所中有颌及相关无颌脊椎动物（鼻孔）的平行且地方性辐射。灭绝后生态系统首次确定出现了古生代“鱼类时代”（及至今）大多数主要脊椎动物谱系，此前普遍存在的茎-环口锥齿兽、其他鼻孔的幼生动物群以及远洋无脊椎动物的消失。更替和恢复模式与气候相似事件后（如泥盆纪末大灭绝）相符，包括生物多样性低的灭绝后“缺口”。志留纪的漫长恢复以及海洋扩散的挑战，很可能在首批化石颚出现后数百万年内，进一步延缓了颌骨口的主导地位。

items.title: Plant diversity enhances ecosystem resistance to increasing grazing pressure in global drylands
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 植物多样性增强全球干旱地区生态系统对日益增加的放牧压力的抵抗力
items.abstract_zh: 理解生态系统对日益增加的牲畜放牧压力的抵抗机制，这是土地退化的主要驱动因素，对于预测其影响和制定可持续土地管理策略至关重要。这个问题在干旱地区尤其重要，因为干旱地区占全球一半的牲畜生产，并且极易因过度放牧而造成荒漠化。在这里，我们在 25 个国家的 73 个干旱地区站点进行了标准化的实地调查，以同时评估气候、土壤、植被和放牧相关因素如何影响生态系统抵抗能力——这里定义的生态系统抵抗能力是指维持植被覆盖在日益增加的放牧压力下的能力。我们发现，在 80%的站点中，增加的放牧压力减少了植被覆盖，平均下降 35%。植物物种多样性成为生态系统抵抗能力最强的预测因子，物种多样性越高，植被覆盖损失越低。功能性状数据表明，这种积极效应主要是由植物性状值之间的互补性所解释，而不是由功能冗余所解释。 我们的结果表明，保护植物多样性是增强生态系统抵抗力和维持干旱地区功能的关键，尤其是在放牧压力加剧的情况下。

items.title: Projected human land-use pressures and natural habitat conversion risk within global terrestrial protected areas
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 全球陆地保护区内的人类土地利用压力和自然栖息地转化风险
items.abstract_zh: 《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》的一个关键目标是：通过保护区和其他有效的区域性保护措施，保护全球至少 30%的土地，以减缓生物多样性丧失。然而，最近的研究表明，在全球陆地保护区网络中存在广泛的栖息地破坏，而未来可预测的栖息地破坏风险如何严重破坏这一目标尚不清楚。在此，我们利用高分辨率卫星数据集和机器学习模型，在各种社会经济和气候情景下，对陆地保护区范围内可能的人为土地利用扩张及其相关的自然栖息地转换风险进行了全球评估。在四种共享社会经济路径（SSP）情景下，预计到 2050 年，保护区内部的人为土地利用将增加 27.50–51.17%。因此，预计有 31.03–39.07%的陆地脊椎动物物种将在保护区内部经历人为主导土地利用的增加。 撒哈拉以南非洲、南美洲和东南亚的保护区尤其面临风险，在这些地区平衡粮食安全、城市化和生物多样性保护需要应对重大挑战。SSP5-代表性浓度路径 8.5（RCP8.5）情景预计将加剧自然栖息地的转变，而 SSP3-RCP7.0 和 SSP2-RCP4.5 的影响相对较低。我们的研究强调了应对加速自然栖息地转变的必要性，确保现有和新设立的保护区在未来威胁面前的韧性。

items.title: National assessment of river protection in the United States
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 美国河流保护国家尺度评估
items.abstract_zh: 为应对淡水面临的持续且日益加剧的危机，许多国家近期已设定了雄心勃勃的淡水保护目标。然而，缺乏综合数据库和整合框架阻碍了对当前淡水保护状况的全面评估，也难以确定未来实现这些目标的机会优先级。本研究通过将纷繁复杂的联邦、州、部落及私人保护机制整合为一个多维度的单一指数，对美国河流保护进行了全面评估。我们发现，美国本土河流总长度的十分之一多一点以及全国河流总数的五分之一以下目前处于被认为可行的保护水平。低地源头溪流和间歇性水域始终保护不足。保护措施也常常在空间上与其他保护目标错位，只有少数生物多样性高、栖息地完整性好且对饮用水供应重要的流域得到了充分保护（河流长度占比达 30%）。 我们对河流保护的评估强调，如果我们想要实现雄心勃勃的保护目标、扭转生物多样性丧失的曲线并确保健康的河流惠及所有人，那么在未来几年内增加新的保护措施并强化现有的保护措施是迫切需要的。

items.title: Decadal-scale observations are key to detecting the stabilizing effects of plant diversity in natural ecosystems
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 十年尺度的观测对于检测植物多样性在自然生态系统中的稳定作用至关重要
items.abstract_zh: 大量实验和理论证据表明植物多样性对生产力时间稳定性有积极影响，但多样性-稳定性关系在自然生态系统中不同时间尺度和多样性维度中的变化仍不明确。通过整合对藏山高山草原进行的全面区域植被调查与全球植物多样性和生产力数据库，我们揭示了区域和全球尺度上一致的时间模式：植物多样性对生产力的稳定作用随时间增强，10至13年接近饱和。值得注意的是，植物系统发育多样性成为长期稳定的主要生物驱动因素。相比之下，植物群落高度对短期稳定性的积极影响更为强烈。这些发现凸显了时间尺度在塑造多样性-稳定性关系中的关键作用，并强调了十年尺度研究的必要性。我们的研究结果进一步支持将系统发育多样性融入保护和管理策略，以维持生态系统在全球变化下的运作。

items.title: Pervasive increase in tree mortality across the Australian continent
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚大陆树木死亡率普遍上升
items.abstract_zh: 气候驱动的背景树木死亡率普遍上升，有可能减少陆地生态系统的碳储存，挑战其作为大气 (CO2) 浓缩的天然缓冲区的有效性，对全球碳预算产生重大影响。然而，全球树木死亡趋势及其驱动因素的量化仍然不足。澳大利亚大陆拥有地球上最为多变的气候之一，拥有多样化的森林生物群落，这些生物群落进化出了高度抗干扰能力，为树木死亡趋势的普遍性提供了宝贵的试验案例。我们汇编了一个 83 年树木动力学数据库（1941–2023），涵盖澳大利亚覆盖热带稀树草原和雨林以及温暖和凉温带森林的>2,700 个森林地块，以探讨树木死亡的时空模式及其相关驱动因素。在过去八十年里，我们发现四种森林生物群系树木死亡率持续上升。考虑到林分结构后，这种时间趋势依然存在，在水分指数低或竞争指数高的森林中表现得更为明显。具有高生长率特征的物种——低木材密度、高特定叶面积和短最大高度——表现出更高的平均死亡率，但不同功能群的死亡率增加率是相当的。死亡率增加与生长增加无关，因为基底面积的增加随时间要么下降，要么保持不变，但与温度随时间升高相关。 我们的发现表明，持续的气候变化推动了森林动态的广泛变化，超出自然恢复范围，这些森林生物群落对干扰具有高度的抗干扰能力，威胁着森林在当前及未来气候情景下持续封存碳的能力。

items.title: Ecological insights from three decades of forest biodiversity experiments
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 三十年森林生物多样性实验的生态洞见
items.abstract_zh: 森林生物多样性实验测试物种多样性如何影响森林生态系统的功能，通常以森林生产力为单位。在本综述中，我们讨论了这些实验的关键发现，并将其与森林观察研究置于背景中。实验研究可以揭示生物多样性对生态系统功能的因果影响，而这在观察性研究中极具挑战性。过去三十年的实验研究表明，增加树木多样性可以通过资源划分、非生物和生物促进以及其他物种间的互动，促进多种生态系统功能。最长期的实验表明，这些关系会随着时间推移增强，而在自然林或人工林中的比较研究表明，这些效应很可能持续存在。此外，其他营养级的多样性也能强烈介导树木多样性对森林生产力的影响。需要新的实验，既控树的多样性，也通过正交处理其他营养级的多样性来探讨这些相互作用中的因果关系。此外，将树木多样性与全球变化因素结合的实验对于理解树木多样性与生态系统在全球变化下功能关系的情境依赖性是必要的。最后，结合观察研究和实验的见解，有助于生物多样性-生态系统功能研究，指导全球生物多样性框架的恢复和森林管理目标。

items.title: Ecological processes shaping Antarctic terrestrial biodiversity change
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.title_zh: 塑造南极陆地生物多样性变化的生态过程
items.abstract_zh: 南极洲在组成和功能上异常的生物多样性在全球生物多样性分析中通常被忽视，生态学理论也很少被应用于南极背景。这些遗漏意味着对全球变化下南极生物多样性未来的预测只能依赖机制理解。在本视角中，我们概述了南极的生物多样性及其陆地环境的关键变化，并讨论了五个核心生态过程（非生物过滤、扩散、适应、生物相互作用和随机性）如何影响大陆上的生物多样性。基于支持这些过程的证据，我们建立了五个非排他性的全球变化下南极陆地生物多样性结果假设：受限、动态、无序、多样化和互动。现有证据最支持受限假说，即非生物条件可能仍然是适应度的主要限制，即使在更温暖、更潮湿的环境中。我们阐述的五个生物多样性结果为南极生物多样性提供了理论驱动、可检验的假设，并识别了优先知识缺口，以减少对其未来的不确定性。
